parsed.reason: The message has multiple issues: (1) It contains padding ("Google may say I'm still in review - no problem if you'd rather wait") that goes beyond what the moment calls for. (4) "I'm still in review" is corporate register inappropriate for this context. The message should simply state the receipt (this link is just for you and nothing from your inbox shows up in this thread) and ask the single required question about catching school and camp emails.
